description: L0 shared mathematical objects, each with its Lean definition cited by name and pinned source.

objects.name: Natural numbers with addition
objects.definition: ℕ with 0, successor, and addition defined by recursion on the second argument; numerals are ℕ literals.

lean.name: Nat.add
lean.note: Lean core, with kernel acceleration for literals

objects.notes: Part of Lean's trusted base (the prelude).

objects.name: Prime integer
objects.definition: An integer z is prime when 0 < z and z, as a natural number, is prime.

objects.name: Admissible shift set
objects.definition: A finite set H of integers is admissible when, for every prime p, some residue class mod p contains no element of H.

objects.name: Consecutive prime gap
objects.definition: primeGap n = p_{n+1} − p_n, with p_0 = 2 the first prime.

objects.name: Local factor ν_p(H)
objects.definition: ν_p(H) is the number of residue classes mod p of the form −h, h ∈ H: the classes H forbids.

objects.name: GDT accepted set
objects.definition: For N, m > 0 and a ∈ ℤ: n is accepted when n ≡ a (mod m) and gcd(n, N) = 1; a is admissible when gcd(a, d) = 1 with d = rad(gcd(m, N)); Tmin = m·rad(N)/d.

objects.name: No fixed prime divisor (Schinzel condition)
objects.definition: A finite set of integer polynomials satisfies the Schinzel condition when for every prime p some natural n makes p divide none of the values f(n).
objects.notes: formal-conjectures builds these in its own CI; the survey holds no verification record for them yet.

objects.name: Residue image of a shift set
objects.definition: residueImage p H is the set of residue classes in ZMod p met by the shifts h ∈ H, the image of H under ℤ → ZMod p.
objects.notes: def residueImage (p : ℕ) (H : Finset ℤ) : Finset (ZMod p) := H.image (fun (h : ℤ) => (h : ZMod p)). Kernel-checked on the user's MBP (EV-0008).
